The '''v-35 Spoiler''' was a model of [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] produced by the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] for the purpose of planetary defense. One of three popular models from KDY's v-series it was considered a light ion cannon, with a surface-to-air capability useful against [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], and was a common weapon emplacement used to defend various strongholds. The Spoiler required a crew of four to operate.<ref name="HS" />
